$comment: Citation registry for the assessment matrix, the pathway descriptions, and the collection guide. Keys here are the only valid values for any 'references' array in matrix.json, pathways.json, or guidance.json. Entries carrying a 'ref' are in the bibliography of González-Espinoza et al. (2026) and the number matches the source paper, so the numbered list on the References page and the paper agree; they are held here in that order. Entries carrying 'source': 'materials-guidance' are cited by the Pathway-C materials sub-domain and are NOT in the paper's bibliography — they have no 'ref' and sort after the numbered list. An entry has a 'ref' or a 'source' tag, never both; matrix.test.js enforces that and the contiguity of the numbering. All six schema files move in lockstep from 0.9.0; 1.0.0 is cut when the criterion ids are considered stable.
